title: docs(components): record_picker `limit` states the composer's precedence (objectui#10399)
body:
Fixes #10399
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`element:record_picker`'s `limit` input description (the authoring description in `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/record-picker.tsx`) used to end "PRECEDENCE: `dataSource.limit ?? limit ?? 50` — a node-level binding wins outright". Two things made it false:

- it skipped the saved view that `dataSource.view` names, whose row cap sits between the binding and the picker's own key;
- under ruling A on objectui#10016 (PR objectui#10389), a binding cap the contract refuses (`0`, a negative, a non-integer) is not authored and falls through.

It also cited the renderer by a line address that had drifted. The description now names four sources in order (`dataSource.limit`, the named view's row cap, THIS key, then 50). It says that a cap in the first two counts only when it is a positive integer, and that a refused one falls through exactly as an absent one does. The line address is replaced by a content description (the trailing `?? 50` where the picker resolves its `limit`).

`content/docs/guide/data-source.md`: the sentence where the binding's `sort` / `limit` override the view now adds the refused-cap fall-through in one sentence.

Text only. No behaviour changes.

## Derivation (from the merged code, not the card)

- `composeElementDataSource` (`@object-ui/core`): `const limit = bindingLimit(config) ?? savedViewLimit(view);`. Both helpers return a cap only when `isUsableRowLimit` holds (an integer greater than zero).
- The picker reads `const limit = composed?.limit ?? props.limit ?? 50;` and `composed` comes from its own `useElementDataSource(schema, adapter)`.
- Result: usable binding cap, then usable view cap, then the picker's `limit`, then 50. This matches triage's reading.

## Sibling `filter` / `sort` descriptions: checked, not edited

The composer has no refused-value fall-through for them: `const sort = config.sort ?? view?.sort;`, and `filter` is `config.filter ?? viewFilter` (or `mergeFilterNodes` when both are set). `isElementDataSourceConfig` checks only `object`. So "wins outright" / "REPLACES" is still true for those two, and they are left unchanged.

## Pin

The existing description test `record-picker-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` gains one case: "the `limit` description states the composer's precedence, not the pre-objectui#10016 one (objectui#10399)". It asserts the description exists (non-vacuity) and does not contain the stale spelling, "wins outright" or a `record-picker.tsx:N` address. It also asserts that it mentions `dataSource.view` and "not authored".

Reverse check, run after the fix was committed: the pre-fix file was restored from `bc4efba73`, and on disk the stale spelling count was 1 and the new text count 0. That case then went red with `expected 'Maximum number of records the picker …' not to contain 'dataSource.limit ?? limit ?? 50'` (`Tests 1 failed | 8 skipped`). The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD`: `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes and the blob hash matches HEAD.

## Verification (head `c71a9dd95`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/`: `Test Files 299 passed | 1 skipped (300)`, `Tests 2910 passed | 17 skipped (2927)`.
- Four named suites (the three record-picker suites, plus `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`): `222 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`: exit 0, after building the dependency closure. `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.ts`.
- eslint on the two touched TS files: 0 errors. There are 10 warnings, all on existing lines of the renderer and none on the edited line or the test. The config is not type-aware, so this narrowing cannot change any verdict on untouched files.
- Exit 0: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence`, `changeset:check` (fixed + no-major), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `docs:check-links`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:component-surface-parity`.
- NOT MEASURED, exit 2 because the prerequisite was not met, so these go to CI: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` need 34 packages built, and the .md edit is prose with no code block. `check:sdui-registration-pins` needs a console build.

Changeset: `.changeset/10399-record-picker-limit-precedence-text.md`, `@object-ui/components` patch. The description string is published source under `src/`.

## Acceptance notes

- `@objectstack/spec` `ElementRecordPickerProps.limit`: its JSDoc still spells `ds.limit ?? props.limit ?? 50`, and its `.describe` says the binding "takes precedence when both are set". For spec-valid values that is true but incomplete, because it does not mention the named view's cap. This is in the sister repo and is not filed.
- The picker's own `limit` is not held to the positivity check: `if (limit) query.$top = limit` sends no `$top` for `0`. The spec refuses `0` for that key at authoring, so the description does not claim it is checked. Nothing is filed.
